actual_request.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, precise-object-edit.
Asset: ONE full native transparent PNG for 06_thunder_caster_boy, SOUTH walk frame 16.
Input 1 is the clean current S16 sprite, EDIT TARGET. Input 2 is original S16, authoritative exact POSE and limb-position reference (ignore its obsolete magenta contaminated edges). Input 3 is clean S14, BODY SIZE reference ONLY; do not copy S14's raised-knee pose. Input 4 is this same boy's identity/costume reference. Input 5 is the approved painted style reference; ignore its UI and other characters.
Make one careful high-resolution repaint of input 1 correcting ONLY its slight overall body-size undershoot. Render the entire figure about 6 percent larger within the same square canvas, preserving the chibi head/body proportions, hand and talisman sizes together. Match the head, face, hands and equipment scale of input 3. Topmost hair should be at 4.5 percent canvas height and lowest boot sole at 95.5 percent, a complete ~91 percent canvas figure height. All tips and boots must have clear empty margins. Native single full image at least1024x1024; prefer1536 if available. Do not crop any part.
Pose stays exactly S16 from inputs1/2: frontal SOUTH, anatomical RIGHT leg on screen LEFT extended forward and low, sole partly visible as it approaches the ground; anatomical LEFT leg on screen RIGHT slightly behind, boot drawn upright. Preserve exact angles/knee height and support/swing relation. Do not use the highly lifted knee of input3, do not mirror or swap legs or replace with idle. Preserve the joyful round-eyed young boy, brown tousled hair/top ponytail, turquoise beads/golden ribbons/yin-yang forehead badge, ivory-gold robe and shoulder plates, navy trousers with lightning patterns, belt and tassels, black/gold boots. Anatomical RIGHT hand holds pointed golden lightning staff on screen LEFT; LEFT hand holds rectangular gold talisman plaque on screen RIGHT. No redesign, no changed hands, no lengthened limbs, no smaller head, no different pose or new gesture.
Keep the clean polished luminous rounded Daoist chibi painted finish from input5 and exact identity from inputs1/4. Genuine transparent alpha outside the silhouette and within gaps. No colored background, ground shadow, checkerboard, particles, glow, border, text or watermark. Clean natural antialiasing colored by adjacent brown/gold/ivory/navy material. Eliminate magenta/red/pink/purple fringe speckles, white halo and black halo. Preserve intentional navy fabric shadow and smooth warm coral-gold staff ornament. Output one complete unique PNG only. Export afterwards uses the SAME fixed whole-canvas .88 common scale and foot anchor y942; do not add any preprocessed bitmap transformation.
